seo.description: Privacy Policy for Chaotic-AUR, a repository of packages for Arch Linux
seo.keywords: Chaotic-AUR, Privacy Policy, Data Protection, GDPR

title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.priority: At aur.chaotic.cx, accessible from aur.chaotic.cx and all of its subdomains, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by chaotic.cx and how we use it.
intro.questions: If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.
intro.scope: This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in aur.chaotic.cx and all of its subdomains. This policy is only applicable to any information collected via our web services.

consent.title: Consent
consent.text: By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

collectedInfo.title: Information we collect
collectedInfo.reasons: The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.
collectedInfo.directContact: If you contact us directly, we may receive additional information about you such as your name, email address, the contents of the message and/or attachments you may send us, and any other information you may choose to provide.
collectedInfo.account: When you register for an Account, we may ask for your email address and username as well as other cause-related information.

useFor.title: How we use your information
useFor.intro: We use the information we collect only to:
useFor.operate: Provide, operate, and maintain our infrastructure
useFor.emails: Send you emails if you signed up for them using one of our web services
useFor.misuse: Find and prevent misuse of the infrastructure
useFor.minimum: We have no interest in your data and only store the bare minimum needed to operate the services we provide to our visitors.

logFiles.title: Log Files
logFiles.text: chaotic.cx follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services' analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing usage, administering the sites, and gathering diagnostic information.

cookies.title: Cookies and Web Beacons
cookies.usage: Like any other website, chaotic.cx uses "cookies". These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to keep users logged into web services and provide the websites functionality.
cookies.disable: You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers' respective websites.

thirdParty.title: Third Party Privacy Policies
thirdParty.notApplicable: chaotic.cx's Privacy Policy does not apply to some of the services we utilize in our infrastructure. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party services for more detailed information.
thirdParty.cloudflare: Cloudflare as CDN and for protection against various things
thirdParty.hetzner: Hetzner as server and backup storage provider
thirdParty.heroku: Heroku as provider which runs our router application
thirdParty.netcup: Netcup as provider for our mail server

dataProtectionRights.title: GDPR Data Protection Rights
dataProtectionRights.intro: We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:
dataProtectionRights.access: The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
dataProtectionRights.rectification: The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete the information you believe is incomplete.
dataProtectionRights.erasure: The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
dataProtectionRights.restrictProcessing: The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
dataProtectionRights.objectToProcessing: The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
dataProtectionRights.dataPortability: The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.

childrenInfo.title: Children's Information
childrenInfo.protection: Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.
childrenInfo.underThirteen: chaotic.cx does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
policyChanges.text: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, we advise you to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. These changes are effective immediately, after they are posted on this page.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.text: If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at root@chaotic.cx.
